pages.text: Ten mods contribute pinned Filament Unit values. These are the items MC3DPrint could not work out on its own, almost always because a custom machine makes them.$(br2)Everything downstream of a pinned item prices itself automatically.

$(l)Tinkers' Construct$(): 16 values, Tiers 2-6. Smeltery alloys, cobalt, and the necrotic bone a wither-skeleton farm produces.$(br2)$(l)Mekanism$(): 14 values, Tiers 2-6 and 8.$(br2)$(l)Botania$(): 11 values, Tiers 3-6.$(br2)$(l)Applied Energistics 2$(): 10 values, Tiers 2-5.
pages.title: Tech and Magic

pages.text: $(l)Ender IO$(): 9 values, Tiers 3-6.$(br2)$(l)Immersive Engineering$(): 7 values, all Tier 3.$(br2)$(l)Create$(): 6 values, Tiers 2-3.$(br2)$(l)Draconic Evolution$(): 6 values, Tiers 7-8.$(br2)$(l)Mystical Agriculture$(): 4 values, Tiers 1-2.$(br2)$(l)Thermal Series$(): 3 values, Tiers 4-5.
pages.title: The Rest

pages.text: Cross-mod materials are deliberately kept level. Steel is steel whether Tinkers', Ender IO or Immersive Engineering made it, so the same material cannot be arbitraged from one mod into another.$(br2)Anything left $(l)unvalued$() is refused by strict mode rather than printed for free.
pages.title: No Arbitrage
